title: Questions
metaTitle: Questions: buying keys, delivery, regions and refunds
metaDescription: Answers about buying game keys, gift cards and subscriptions from {brand}: delivery to your account, regions, redeeming, card payment, refunds and your account.
lead: Short, plain answers. The full wording is in our <policies>policies</policies>.
stillNeedHelpBody: Write to us and we reply {replyTime}. Support hours: {supportHours}.

place.q: How do I order a key?
place.a: Sign in, add keys to your cart and go to checkout. Add your billing details, tick the confirmation boxes and pay on the payment provider’s hosted page. Your receipt and invoice arrive by email once the payment is confirmed.

account.a: Yes. Every key is issued to your {brand} account and shown only to you, so you need to be signed in to check out. Registration has four short steps.

limits.q: How many keys can I buy at once?
limits.a: An order can hold up to {maxItems} keys and be worth up to {maxValue}. Gift cards and top-ups are limited to {cardLimit} per product in an order, and to {cardLimit24h} keys or {cardValue24h} per customer in 24 hours. Each product page shows its own limit.

subscriptions.q: Do subscriptions renew on their own?
subscriptions.a: No. A subscription code covers the length shown and we never charge you again. To keep it going, you renew it yourself with the platform.

affiliation.q: Are you part of Steam, Xbox or PlayStation?
affiliation.a: No. {brand} is an independent store and isn’t affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms or publishers whose keys it offers. Their names and artwork belong to them.

time.a: Keys are delivered to your account, {usual}. A bank or security check can make it take longer. If we can’t issue a key within {deadlineHours} hours of payment confirmation, we refund it.

how.q: Where do I find my key?
how.a: In Account → Keys. Choose Reveal key, then copy it. We email you when a key is ready; for your security the email doesn’t contain the key.

noEmail.q: I paid but no email arrived.
noEmail.a: Look in your spam or promotions folder first. The receipt is sent once the payment provider confirms the payment, and your order page shows where the order is. If your card was charged and nothing has arrived, contact us.

safety.q: Is my key safe in my account?
safety.a: Keys are stored encrypted and shown only to the signed-in account that bought them, when you choose Reveal key. Keep a key to yourself until you redeem it: anyone who sees it can use it.

region.q: What does the region on a key mean?
region.a: A Global key works on an account set to any country we serve. A Europe, United Kingdom, United States or North America key activates only on an account set to that region. The region is on every product page and in your cart.

redeem.q: Where do I enter my key?
redeem.a: On the platform named on the product page: for example Games › Activate a Product on Steam, Redeem code in the EA app, or redeem.microsoft.com for Xbox. Each platform’s steps are in <howto>How activation works</howto> and next to the key in your account.

language.q: Which languages does a game have?
language.a: The product page lists the languages the publisher gives for that key. Some keys cover only some languages, so check the list if a language matters to you.

giftCards.q: Which gift card should I pick?
giftCards.a: The one for the region your platform account is set to. A card adds its value, in the currency shown, only to an account in that region.

safe.q: Do you see my card details?
safe.a: No. You enter your card details on our PCI DSS compliant payment provider’s hosted page; we receive only the confirmation, the amount and your order number. We never see or store your full card number. Your bank may ask you to approve the payment with 3-D Secure.

methods.a: By {cardMethods} card, on the payment provider’s hosted page. Other payment methods aren’t available.

currencies.q: Which currencies can I pay in?
currencies.a: {currencies}. You’re charged in the currency chosen at checkout. If your card uses another currency, your bank may add a conversion fee.

vatNo.a: {company} isn’t registered for VAT, so no VAT is charged or added at checkout.

vatYes.a: Yes. Prices include VAT at the rate that applies to your order.

when.a: When you complete the payment on the provider’s page. We ask for your key only after the payment is confirmed. If a payment is declined or cancelled, nothing is charged.

notWorking.q: My key doesn’t work. What happens now?
notWorking.a: Check that the platform and region match your account. If it still fails, report it from the key in your account within {claimDays} days of delivery, with a screenshot of the error. Our check takes up to {reviewDays} business days; a faulty key is swapped for a new one, or refunded when no replacement exists. See <warranty>Key not working?</warranty>.

cancel.q: Can I cancel or get a refund?
cancel.a: You can cancel free of charge before {cancelBefore}: email {email} with your order number. At checkout you ask for delivery straight after payment, so the {withdrawalDays}-day right to cancel ends once a key is issued. We refund if we can’t issue a key within {deadlineHours} hours or a faulty key can’t be replaced. Refunds go to {refundMethod} within {refundDays} days. See the <returns>Refund policy</returns>.

unwanted.q: Can I return a key I no longer want?
unwanted.a: Not once it has been issued and works as described, for example if you changed your mind or bought the wrong platform when the product page named it correctly. Check the platform, region and edition before you buy.

who.a: You can open one if you are {minAge} or older and live in a country we serve. We don’t open accounts in or take orders from {restricted}, or {territories}.

password.a: Choose Forgot your password on the sign-in page and we’ll email you a link to set a new one.

delete.q: How do I close my account?
delete.a: Email {email} from your account’s address. We close the account and delete your data, except what the law requires us to keep, as set out in the <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>. Keys you’ve already redeemed stay on the platforms where you redeemed them.
